purpose: Test whether independently measured total baryonic potential, rather than a galaxy/cluster class label, completes the U0 bridge.
prior_art: Potential-dependent acceleration scales and external-potential effects are not claimed as original; U0 remains an EMOND-like control.

model.name: E0_independent_total_baryon_potential
host_components: central stellar component only if it is not already included in chi_self

forbidden_inputs: a constant host-potential offset inferred from BCG residuals
dark-matter mass inferred from the target dynamics or lensing
refitting F, chi_t, w_dex, or a0
measurement_firewall.primary_confirmation_sample: systems whose target kinematics or lensing values were not used in SPARC+CLASH fitting and were not among the 50 inspected MaNGA BCG rows
measurement_firewall.manga_bcg_role: conditional reconstruction check only; no longer a blind confirmation sample

uncertainty.profile_method: propagate gas and stellar profile posteriors into chi_host_bar and g_pred

advancement_gate: lower held-out chi2 per point than the frozen self-only U0 prediction
paired 95 percent complete-system bootstrap interval for E0 minus self-only U0 lies below zero
absolute mean log-residual magnitude is smaller than for self-only U0
no fitted potential offset or class label is introduced
the sign and scale of the effect survive documented gas-profile extrapolation alternatives
rejection_rule: Reject E0 in this form if independently measured host baryonic potentials do not remove the systematic underprediction or if success requires fitting an offset from the target observable.
